title: Retrieve What Helps, Only When It Helps: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Selective Retrieval-Augmented Machine Translation
abstract: arXiv:2610.19528v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieving external knowledge can improve large language model (LLM) translation by providing supplementary information such as idiom interpretations and terminology. However, existing retrieval-augmented machine translation systems typically apply predefined retrieval strategies uniformly across all inputs. We argue that translation operates in a partial-evidence regime: LLM's parametric knowledge suffices for many inputs, while external evidence benefits a subset and usually supports rather than directly provides the desired translation. This creates two challenges: deciding when to retrieve and what evidence to acquire. We introduce Selective Retrieval-Augmented Translation (SRAT), an agentic reinforcement learning framework that learns when to translate directly or retrieve, what to retrieve, and how to integrate these decisions by optimizing final translation quality. translated_title: 只在有帮助时检索有帮助的内容：面向选择性检索增强机器翻译的智能体强化学习
translated_abstract: 检索外部知识可以通过提供诸如习语解释和术语等补充信息来提升大语言模型（LLM）的翻译质量。然而，现有的检索增强机器翻译系统通常对所有输入统一应用预定义的检索策略。我们认为翻译处于一种“部分证据”机制中：LLM的参数化知识足以应对许多输入，而外部证据只对其中一部分输入有益，且通常是辅助性的，而非直接提供所需的译文。这带来了两个挑战：决定何时检索以及获取何种证据。我们提出了选择性检索增强翻译（SRAT），这是一个智能体式强化学习框架，通过优化最终翻译质量，学习何时直接翻译、何时进行检索、检索什么内容，以及如何整合这些决策。为了使证据检索与下游翻译质量对齐…
tldr: 该论文提出SRAT智能体强化学习框架，让大语言模型在翻译中自主学习何时需要检索外部知识、检索什么证据以及如何整合，从而只在检索真正有助于翻译质量时才进行检索。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SRAT, an agentic reinforcement learning framework that learns when to translate directly versus retrieve, what evidence to acquire, and how to integrate these decisions, enabling LLMs to selectively leverage retrieval only when it genuinely improves translation quality.
